title: Nebula Commerce Engine
shortDescription: AI-assisted storefront with realtime conversion analytics and cinematic checkout UX.
longDescription: Nebula Commerce Engine blends conversion-focused design and custom analytics. Built with Next.js and edge functions, it tracks user behavior in realtime and surfaces conversion opportunities through live dashboards.

title: Pulse Stream Dashboard
shortDescription: Streaming metrics dashboard for creators with low-latency data and scene controls.
longDescription: A high-frequency dashboard designed for streamers and esports teams. It includes modular widgets, low-latency websocket feeds, and alerting presets for traffic spikes.

title: Orbit CMS Studio
shortDescription: Headless content management toolkit with block editor and granular publishing workflows.
longDescription: Orbit CMS Studio gives teams a visual block editor, content versioning, and role-based workflows. Optimized for rapid campaign launches and multi-channel content delivery.

title: Arcade Labs Portal
shortDescription: Gamified product-launch portal with missions, rewards, and social progress tracking.
longDescription: A community-first launch platform featuring mission-based onboarding, leaderboard APIs, and event-driven notifications. Designed for product teams and creator communities.

title: Vault Ops Console
shortDescription: Operations command center for deployment health, incidents, and rollback controls.
longDescription: Vault Ops Console centralizes deployment visibility and incident handling with actionable timelines and command shortcuts. Engineered for fast incident response.

title: Echo Contact AI
shortDescription: Conversational support layer that summarizes tickets and suggests instant responses.
longDescription: Echo Contact AI helps support teams resolve cases faster using intent grouping and draft suggestions. Includes SLA tracking and quality scorecards.

title: Stellar Feed
shortDescription: High-performance content feed with ranking, personalization, and trend detection.
longDescription: Stellar Feed powers personalized content streams using ranking signals and trend heuristics. Built to remain fast under sustained traffic bursts.

title: Nova Notes
shortDescription: Minimal writing app with markdown, sync, and focus-mode collaboration.
longDescription: Nova Notes combines realtime collaboration and distraction-free writing workflows. Includes markdown publishing, keyboard-first commands, and encrypted sync.
